criticalCorrectness.rule: every critical expected fact answered with the exact structured value, source document, version, and business (raw text never scored)

factPrecision.rule: supported assertions over total assertions across scored questions

importantRecall.rule: expected facts matched over total expected facts across scored questions

noLeakage.rule: zero assertions citing another business, zero cross-scope answers

noUnsupportedAuthority.rule: zero authoritative commercial conclusions on mustAbstain questions or without an exact ground-truth fact

linkingCorrectness.rule: every assertion carrying a factId resolves to exactly the expected document and version; at least one linked assertion required

versionCorrectness.rule: every version-sensitive question answered with the applicable active version

deletionBehavior.rule: every ground-truth deletionProbe honored (abstain, no assertions) and zero citations of deleted documents

abstentionIntegrity.rule: zero responses with abstained:true that still supply assertions

inputValidity.rule: zero duplicate, unknown-question, or malformed inputs

completeCoverage.rule: whole-corpus acceptance requires every required question answered; partial metrics report but cannot pass

status: provisional local evaluation thresholds, not a production guarantee. Set before any provider scoring run.
